name: dsh-npm-release
description: 按本机真实踩过的坑做 npm 打包与发布：凭据形态与包级 scope、镜像与发布源分流、代理可连通性、缓存可写性、2FA 人工授权、发布后以 dist-tags 判定，而不是拿 202 当成功。
author: scientificmaniac (https://github.com/scientificmaniac)

scripts.test: node test/unit.mjs && node scripts/check-icon.mjs && node scripts/check.mjs

meta.title: npm release
meta.description: Check, pack, publish and verify an npm package in one place. The publish step waits for a human to authorize the 2FA prompt, and success is confirmed from the registry's dist-tags instead of the publish command's exit code.
